Its glass was green, its cork blackened, and a folded note waited inside. The paper bore a date from forty years earlier and a child’s careful handwriting: “If anyone finds this, tell my father I made it home.” He read the line twice, then carried it up the tower and searched the old logbooks. A name appeared in an entry from the same winter: a fisherman lost beyond the reef, leaving a daughter with relatives inland. At dawn, the keeper sent a copy of the message to the village archive. Years later, a woman came to the lighthouse with silver hair and a small brass compass. She said her father had made it home after all, but the bottle had taken the long way.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有完全醒来。路灯把湿漉漉的街道照成淡金色，最后一班公交车驶过空荡的路口，车窗里映着几张疲倦的脸。早点铺掀开卷帘门，蒸汽带着面香升上寒冷的空气。清洁工推着车慢慢前行，扫帚划过地面，发出轻轻的沙沙声。高楼之间，几扇窗仍亮着灯，像夜色里迟迟不肯闭上的眼睛。远处传来鸟鸣，天边泛起微弱的灰白。这个时刻没有白日的喧闹，也没有深夜的寂静，整座城市仿佛屏住呼吸，悄悄等待第一缕晨光。","w03":"- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that one until you find a toy.\n- It needs a stopping point, or it would keep opening smaller boxes forever."}
